text.p: Just 315 fishermen have been found safe and 985 men are still missing after a massive cyclone which lashed the south east Indian coast last week, a spokesman at the relief control room told Reuters on Tuesday.
He said other news agency reports that around 1,000 men had come ashore were incorrect.
"No, 315 fishermen have been found, 985 are still missing. These are the correct figures," Vijay Kumar, a senior official coordinating relief work from state capital in Hyderabad, told Reuters.
The Press Trust of India news agency had earlier reported, quoting an official at the Andra Pradesh state relief department, that around 1,000 men had reached safety.

Officials had estimated that the maximum death toll could reach would be 2,000 as they waited to learn the fate of some 1,300 men who set sail in the Bay of Bengal before the cyclone struck last Wednesday.
